excerpts.text: `Shimmer` is a super-light modifier that adds a "shimmering" effect to any SwiftUI `View`, for example, to show that an operation is in progress. It works well on light and dark modes, left-to-right and right-to-left layout directions, and across all Apple platforms: iOS, macOS, tvOS, watchOS and even visionOS! 📱💻🖥️📺⌚️🥽✨
